title: Documentation Generation Utilities
summary: This module provides various utilities for generating and enhancing documentation, including scripts for API reference creation, MkDocs navigation updates, and a client-side feature to copy page content as Markdown. It also includes a script for generating synthetic data for tutorials.

nodes.label: Create Copy-as-Markdown Button
nodes.title: Client-side Markdown Copy Button
nodes.description: Generates a JavaScript button on documentation pages, allowing users to copy the page's content as Markdown. This enhances user experience for content sharing and reuse.

nodes.label: Generate API Markdown Docs
nodes.title: API Documentation Generator
nodes.description: Scans the `dspy` package to automatically generate structured Markdown documentation files for all public classes and functions, organizing them by API category.

nodes.label: Update MkDocs Navigation
nodes.title: MkDocs Navigation Updater
nodes.description: Reads and modifies the `mkdocs.yml` configuration file to dynamically include the newly generated API documentation structure within the site's navigation menu.

nodes.label: Generate Cohort Analysis Data
nodes.title: Tutorial Data Generator
nodes.description: A Python script that synthesizes realistic user, subscription, and event data, saving it to Parquet files for use in dataframe-based cohort analysis tutorials.

nodes.label: MkDocs Configuration File
nodes.title: mkdocs.yml
nodes.description: The primary configuration file for the MkDocs static site generator, which defines the overall site structure, navigation, and theme settings.

nodes.label: Generated API Markdown Files
nodes.title: API Docs Output Directory
nodes.description: A directory containing the automatically generated Markdown files that constitute the dspy API reference documentation, organized into subdirectories by category.

nodes.label: User Web Browser
nodes.title: Documentation Viewer
nodes.description: The client-side environment where users access and interact with the generated documentation, including features like the copy-as-markdown button.

nodes.label: Synthetic Parquet Data
nodes.title: Tutorial Data Storage
nodes.description: Parquet files (e.g., `users.parquet`, `subscriptions.parquet`, `events.parquet`) storing synthetic dataset for various documentation tutorials.

groups.label: Documentation Generation Scripts
groups.title: Automated Documentation Generation
groups.description: Scripts responsible for programmatically creating and organizing API reference documentation and updating the site's navigation.

groups.label: Client-Side Enhancements
groups.title: Interactive Documentation Features
groups.description: Components that add interactive functionality to the documentation website for improved user experience.

groups.label: Tutorial Data Provisioning
groups.title: Synthetic Data for Tutorials
groups.description: A utility for creating synthetic datasets used in various documentation tutorials, particularly for data analysis examples.
